title: TPC Decoder
text: Turbo product code (TPC) decoder, 1 input, 2 outputs; {Extended codes}, {Number of rows in code, Nr} sets the number of rows in product code matrix, {Number of rows in message, Kr} sets the number of rows in message matrix, {Specify shortened message length} sets the shortened message length for rows, {Number of rows in shortened message, Sr} sets the number of rows in shortened message matrix, {Number of columns in code, Nc} sets the number of columns in product code matrix, {Number of columns in message, Kc} sets the number of columns in message matrix, {Number of columns in shortened message, Sc}, {Maximum number of iterations} sets the maximum number of decoding iterations, {Stop iterating when code converges} sets the stop decoding based on the calculated syndrome or parity-check of the component, {Output number of iterations executed} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Iter
ports.summary: Actual number of decoding iterations positive integer

params.name: Extended codes
params.values: Extended codes indicator for TPC row parameters on (default) | off

params.name: Number of rows in code, Nr
params.values: Number of rows in product code matrix 16 (default) | integer

params.name: Number of rows in message, Kr
params.values: Number of rows in message matrix 11 (default) | integer

params.name: Specify shortened message length
params.values: Specify shortened message length for rows off (default) | on

params.name: Number of rows in shortened message, Sr
params.values: Number of rows in shortened message matrix 9 (default) | integer

params.name: Number of columns in code, Nc
params.values: Number of columns in product code matrix 32 (default) | integer

params.name: Number of columns in message, Kc
params.values: Number of columns in message matrix 26 (default) | integer

params.name: Number of columns in shortened message, Sc
params.values: Number of columns in shortened message matrix 22 (default) | integer

params.name: Maximum number of iterations
params.values: Maximum number of decoding iterations 4 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Stop iterating when code converges
params.values: Stop decoding based on the calculated syndrome or parity-check of the component code on (default) | off

params.name: Output number of iterations executed
params.values: Output number of iterations executed off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
